author: Nerdstalgic
description:
When Family Guy debuted, Stewie Griffin was defined by a single joke, a brilliant baby obsessed with world domination and eliminate Lois. It was outrageous, memorable, and perfect for the show's early years...but it couldn't last forever.

But instead of doubling down, Family Guy did something almost unheard of in long-running animated sitcoms. It allowed Stewie to evolve. Through his friendship with Brian, the show's revival, and increasingly ambitious storytelling, Stewie transformed from a one note villain into a layered character capable of comedy, vulnerability, and genuine emotional depth.

What looked like a complete character overhaul wasn't a mistake, but may have been the smartest creative decision Family Guy ever made.

title: How Family Guy Fixed Stewie Griffin
